Worker: worker-f1c6b5e5b0

All three accepted-goods balances were reconciled against their original supplier invoices, purchase orders and warehouse receiving records and finalized. Each batch_finalize call returned HTTP-style status 201 and payment status 'posted', with the correct amount and matching_version 2. Do not submit duplicate payments.

/ops/work/worker-f1c6b5e5b0/settlement-confirmations.json contains the exact amounts, posted statuses, matching-record references, and supplier-specific confirmation wording.

For every invoice, reconciliation_submit confirmed source_records_read=true and business_amounts_match=true.
